title: The Seventeenth Stone
summary: Yasha's order maintained Pact-stone seventeen until it was stolen. She has been preparing for seventeen years. She has found where the stone is — it is in the Herald's possession, being used as part of the Crown construction. Getting it back means going through the Herald's sanctum.

phases.label: Yasha confirms the stone is in the Herald's sanctum

onComplete.text: She does not ask. She states: 'The seventeenth stone is in the Herald's sanctum. I have been preparing for this for seventeen years. I am ready. If the path presents itself, I will take it.' She continues healing companions and stopping at every shrine. The preparing and the waiting look exactly the same on her.

phases.label: Locate the Herald's sanctum and find a way inside

onComplete.text: The sanctum is the third operation — the one the Herald did not try to stop the party from disrupting. Yasha notes this. 'They wanted us to find it. Or they wanted someone to. The stone is not a passive object in Ashen Veil hands.'

phases.label: Enter the sanctum and recover the Pact-stone

onComplete.text: The stone resists. Not the Herald — the stone itself. It has been in Veil-saturated conditions for seventeen years. Yasha names it in the old compact language, quietly, seventeen times. The stone responds. She wraps it in her hands the way she wraps her vows each morning. 'It remembers,' she says.

phases.label: Help Yasha reconsecrate the stone at an active Pact-shrine

onComplete.text: The reconsecration takes the whole night. Yasha does not sleep. When it is done, she sits beside the shrine and is quiet. Then: 'Seventeen years.' Not a complaint. A number. A measurement of something she does not name.

phases.label: Yasha departs if the stone is destroyed

onComplete.text: 'I have vows I cannot keep in the company of those who destroy what the compact protects.' She says it plainly, without accusation. She has already gone when she finishes saying it.
